retrieval_policy.allowed_future_sources: Source-listed public locations or other explicitly authorized sources, with preference for official MIT hosts.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content: Do not authenticate, bypass access controls, scrape prohibited content, or copy solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, secrets, or another learner's work.
verification_before_use: Record the exact URL or local source, retrieval time, version or commit when available, and content hash.
Confirm availability, authorship, license or permitted use, and whether the item is an official course unit.
Scan learner-facing artifacts for solutions, rubric text, hidden evaluation data, secrets, and cross-learner content.
Keep linked, described, retrieved, validated, and unavailable as distinct states.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: A link or catalog claim alone never becomes an available official unit; deterministic ingestion and worker-harness-controlled validation are required.
retrieval_policy.failure_handling: Preserve the unavailable or blocked record and its reason; never fabricate a replacement or silently relabel manager-authored material as official.
